_comment: circuit-agent configuration — edit these values before starting

api._note: Public CIRCUIT API. Self-hosters: change to http://localhost:18960 and set CIRCUIT_INTERNAL_KEY in .env to bypass payment.

strategy._strategy_note: buyCooldownMinutes: skip re-entry on the same mint for this many minutes after closing a position. paperTrading: true enables paper mode — no real swaps, free data sources only. paperSolBalance: starting virtual SOL for paper mode. deadMoneyMinutes/deadMoneyRangePct/deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes: exit early if pnl stays within ±deadMoneyRangePct for deadMoneyMinutes (after holding at least deadMoneyMinHoldMinutes).

circuit._note: Agent will warn when CIRCUIT balance drops below this (for API payment top-up)

llm._note: provider: 'openrouter' (cloud) or 'ollama' (local). baseUrl overrides provider default. openrouterKey or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var.

survival._note: Warn when SOL < minSolWarning. Pause new buys when SOL < minSolPause. circuitReinvestPct: fraction of each profit used to buy CIRCUIT (0.25 = 25%).

reflect._note: Self-improvement loop interval (default 4h). autoApply: true = auto-apply suggested config changes within safe bounds.

telegram._note: Set token here OR in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var. heartbeatChatId = your Telegram user ID to receive heartbeat messages.

heartbeat._note: intervalMs: proactive check-in cadence (default 5 min, 0 to disable). contextRefreshMs: how often to refresh cached SOL price + Fear & Greed index (default 30 min).

swarm._note: autoPublish: emit buy/sell signals automatically on trade execution. minReputationToFollow: only factor signals from agents above this reputation score (0-100). consensusBoostFactor: scale entry size when swarm consensus agrees (e.g. 1.2 = 20% larger). consensusBoostMinScore: independent score must reach this before the boost applies (null = minScanScore+10). blacklistVerifyTopN: re-verify swarm blacklist entries against RugCheck for the top N scored candidates before filtering — prevents hallucinated blacklist entries from silently dropping good trades.

agentLoop._note: How often the agent reasons about and updates its session strategy (default 90 min). The LLM sets mode/patternFilter/minScore for the next window. Modes: active (auto-buy best scorer), selective (LLM gate per candidate), watchOnly (scan only, no buys).

dashboard._note: Local web dashboard at http://localhost:18800 (loopback only — use SSH tunnel for remote access). apiKey: require x-api-key header on all API routes. allowCors: explicit origin to allow (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000') — leave empty to disable CORS entirely.
